game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market, a forest mushroom market: the fairy gardener must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Reverse Countdown: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market: a forest mushroom market
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Market, repeat each round: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches. Each round, a new vine ropes challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the launch_timing value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 70 points of vine ropes by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 70, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Reverse Countdown
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reverse Countdown' (Week 5 slot 8), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Mushroom Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how launch_timing changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Mushroom Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 70 within 42 seconds.
